candidates.red_team_argument: This is the one lead where repository data does provide real structure, and the structure argues against the trade rather than for it. Over the last ten sessions in data/eu_quote_history.csv the high-to-low range is 1.5% of price — an unusually tight coil. In isolation that reads as a setup; in context it is the signature of a stock pinned by a pending takeover process, and the prior report records a July Uber business-combination path. A breakout from a deal-pinned range is a deal-terms event, not a technical breakout, and a structural stop cannot protect against a deal headline gapping the stock in either direction. Add a EUR 11.19B market cap that requires larger-cap exception treatment and a 2026-08-27 date that could not be re-verified (ir.deliveryhero.com refused at the gateway), and there is nothing here that survives.
candidates.rejection_reason: Primary source unreachable — ir.deliveryhero.com refused at the egress gateway, so the 2026-08-27 date is secondary_only. The tight 1.5% ten-day range reflects takeover pinning rather than a tradeable coil, and a normal stop cannot price deal-headline gap risk. Larger-cap exception bucket with no superior setup.
